data.narrative:
Southern Launch is a growth-stage space and aerospace company founded by Lloyd Damp. The valuation universe comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private competitors including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space, totaling 13 comparable firms in the Space & Aerospace sector.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable to this analysis. Peer-median benchmarking cannot be executed because the comparable set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting relevance thresholds—while 11 same-sector peers exist, filtering for stage-appropriate and valuation-tier-aligned comparables yields fewer than the minimum 3 datapoints required for statistical credibility. Public-comp anchoring using the sector P/S median of 23.9x across 6 public tickers likewise cannot proceed, as Southern Launch's revenue figures are not on file; private companies rarely disclose such metrics, precluding application of this multiple-based method.

The absence of applicable quantitative anchors limits this valuation to qualitative positioning within the competitive landscape. Any credible range estimate would require either (1) disclosure of Southern Launch's revenue or near-term revenue guidance, enabling public-multiple application, or (2) identification of 3+ private peers at identical stage and comparable scale. Current data constraints prevent numerical synthesis. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer concentration, and development stage within growth-phase operations.
